title: The letter
topic: acceptance test for performance sequencing and acting direction (Standard v2.1 CA-P, test D4)
hook: Mira walks to the desk and stops.
promise: One continuous performance: walk, stop, look, pick up, read, react, turn and explain.

takeaway.text: What do we say first when the news is bad?

scenes.narration: Mira walks to the desk and stops. A letter is waiting for her. She picks it up without a word.
scenes.visualIdea: Mira crosses the room to the desk, sees the letter and takes it.

scenes.narration: She reads it slowly, line by line, and her face falls.
scenes.visualIdea: Close on Mira reading; the news lands.

scenes.narration: She turns to Ben and tries to explain the problem. The rent went up again, and our savings cannot cover it.
scenes.visualIdea: Mira turns to Ben and explains, worried, avoiding his eyes.

scenes.narration: Ben listens, then answers calmly. We will find a way, together, one step at a time.
scenes.visualIdea: Ben reassures her; she breathes again.
